caption: The drawing depicts an ornate classical interior scene with an elaborate archway framing the composition. The archway is decorated with gold details, blue oval medallions, carved embellishments, and draped green curtains with gold trim. Inside the arch, there are tall marble columns with bases and capitals, supporting a ceiling with additional decorative green and gold drapery. A checkered floor in cream and brown covers the foreground, upon which rests a red patterned tablecloth on a small table. On the table is a blue vase containing a bouquet of large pink and purple flowers. Beside the table are two red-upholstered, gold-trimmed chairs with curved legs and backs. To the right of the table stands a gold candelabrum with five globes. Large, footed planters overflowing with pink flowers are positioned to the left and far right, near the balustrade. The background reveals an open loggia leading to an exterior garden with lush greenery and classical sculptures set within arched niches. Additional decorative urns and trimmed hedges are visible, with a blue sky above. The color palette consists mainly of cream, gold, green, blue, and red, with floral accents and lush foliage throughout.
title: Burlesque Stage Backdrop
